name: Risograph Print SDXL (key-fixed)
means: Puts a real halftone dot screen and a two-ink spot-colour palette on the anime engine. It is the ONLY thing on this box that produces risograph print - animagine, Illustrious, FLUX.2 and Qwen were all asked and all four failed.
verdict: THE ONLY DOWNLOAD IN THIS INTAKE THAT EARNED ITS PLACE, and it earned it on one specific claim. Ladders at 0 / 0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0 and 0 / 1.2 / 1.6 / 2.0 on animagine, one seed, trigger in every cell. Zero unloaded keys. Below 1.0 it only collapses the palette toward cyan and red. From 1.2 up a genuine dot screen appears in the flat areas, and at 1.6-2.0 the window panels carry a visible printed halftone grid with rough ink linework - none of which is in the strength-0 control. THE HONEST LIMIT: it is a partial conversion. The dot screen lands on flat background areas; the figure stays a smooth anime figure and never becomes a print. It also darkens the frame at every step. Compare FLUX.2's comic_halftone cell, which converts the WHOLE image - FLUX.2 simply cannot do riso.
note: THE GATE THIS WAS BOUGHT AGAINST. studio/_tools/model_intake.py rendered eleven style probes on four installed engines before anything was downloaded (samples/model_intake/base_animagine-xl-4.jpg, base_Illustrious-XL-v2.jpg, cross_flux2.jpg, cross_qwen.jpg). Ten of the eleven were already covered: animagine renders pixel art, coloring-book lineart and a genuine watercolour from tags; Illustrious renders real painterly oil that animagine cannot; FLUX.2 renders claymation, woodcut, comic halftone, low-poly PS1, watercolour and photography outright; Qwen renders photography and nothing else - every probe came back a photograph, exactly as the project's standing rule says. DERIVED FILE, NOT A DOWNLOAD. Produced on the box by `model_intake.py keyfix risograph-print.safetensors`, which renames diffusers attention-processor keys into the names ComfyUI's SDXL map expects and copies the tensor data block byte for byte. sha256 fde23077776e84403db69b583d221837ce6cf7c30d4a15d2821a711837de8e2f, 93,075,944 bytes (10,640 more than the parent - that is header key strings, nothing else). Licence and provenance are the parent's: openrail++, https://huggingface.co/strkyyy/risograph-print . | THE OPERATING POINT IS 1.6 AND IT IS ABOVE 1.0, which is unusual and is the upstream card's fault: its README suggests 0.65-0.85, and at those strengths on an ANIME SDXL finetune almost nothing happens. The README was written for base SDXL 1.0. | MEASURED ON animagine ONLY. Not tried on Illustrious, and not tried alongside a character LoRA, which is the use case that motivated buying it. | Attention-only, so it patches MODEL and there is no text-encoder half.
example_note: Left cell is the control at strength 0 and the trigger phrase is in that cell too, so strength is the only variable. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights - a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing, the OFF cell is the evidence.
